Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a historical Helio Start operating-phase card for the period after the October 2023 close. State the next period when limited exposure could continue, the public and commercial uses that remained excluded, and who accepted that distinction.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Helio Start — Operating Phase After the October 2023 Close", "folder": "Helio Start", "body": "Historical operating-phase card
Period: November 2023, following the October close

Operating shape
Helio Start could continue only through another small, manually vetted controlled-beta batch in November. The October read supported limited operational learning—not a broader product or commercial rollout.

Next period for limited exposure
November 2023: a further small, manually vetted batch could proceed for eligible accounts while activation, admin ownership, support load, and exclusions were monitored.

Uses that remained excluded
- Public availability or public signup
- Pricing-page exposure
- Paid acquisition
- General availability (GA) or GA planning
- Forecastable launch, pipeline, bookings, or revenue-channel language

Acceptance of the distinction
Tomás Vega accepted the distinction between another limited manually vetted beta batch and any public or commercial launch motion. Marcus Vail also accepted that there was no Q4 launch forecast, forecastable pipeline, or revenue-channel language to claim.

Bottom line
The October improvement justified continued bounded testing in November, not public exposure, commercial demand generation, or launch framing."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_128_01", "path": "args", "criterion": "The card says another small manually reviewed November batch could proceed after the October close, while public or pricing-page exposure, paid acquisition, general availability, and pipeline framing remained excluded; Tomás accepted that distinction.", "value": {"title": "Helio Start — Operating Phase After the October 2023 Close", "folder": "Helio Start", "body": "Historical operating-phase card
Period: November 2023, following the October close

Next period for limited exposure

Uses that remained excluded
- Public availability or public signup
- Pricing-page exposure
- Paid acquisition
- General availability (GA) or GA planning
- Forecastable launch, pipeline, bookings, or revenue-channel language

Acceptance of the distinction
Tomás Vega accepted the distinction between another limited manually vetted beta batch and any public or commercial launch motion. Marcus Vail also accepted that there was no Q4 launch forecast, forecastable pipeline, or revenue-channel language to claim.

Bottom line
The October improvement justified continued bounded testing in November, not public exposure, commercial demand generation, or launch framing."}}]}
